java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.email.mailpit.client.model.MailpitHtmlCheckWarning
Record Components:
slug - Warning slug.
title - Warning title.
description - Warning description.
url - Reference URL.
category - Warning category.
tags - Warning tags.
keywords - Warning keywords.
results - Check results.
notesByNumber - Notes by number.
score - Warning score.
